business_scope.primary_industry_name: Delivery-Only Multi-Brand Cloud Kitchen Facility Operations

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid: English Common Law statutory foundation overlaid with fa'amatai customary law; offshore company law codified in the International Companies Act 1987
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus (PACER-Plus) 2017
Samoa-China Investment and Economic Cooperation Framework MOUs
Network of Tax Information Exchange Agreements (Australia, New Zealand, Pacific Island peers); no active bilateral investment treaty specifically protecting ghost-kitchen digital brand assets

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: International Companies Act 1987 (as amended by the International Companies Amendment Act 2011); Companies (Amendment) Act 2016 (statutory beneficial ownership register); Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act 2018 (AML/CFT Act 2018, commenced November 2019); Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) Regulations under the Ministry of Finance; Business Licenses Act 1998 for any onshore food-service footprint

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified Color Copy of Passport of each Director, Shareholder and Ultimate Beneficial Owner (between 25% and 100% ownership)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport-issuing authority of the individual's country of residence/nationality
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (for Apostille Convention states, e.g., China since 7 November 2023) OR Consular Legalization (non-Convention states)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of Residential Address (utility bill or bank statement, dated within the last 6 months)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed utility provider or licensed commercial bank in the jurisdiction of residence

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation, Certificate of Good Standing and Register of Directors/Shareholders of any corporate shareholder (holding entity) of the Samoa International Company
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Official companies registry of the corporate shareholder's home jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Professional Banker's KYC Reference Letter for the intended settlement account (UberEats/DoorDash payout bank) or for the agent's CDD file
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Commercial bank maintaining the prospective payout account
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Direct bank-to-agent verification acceptable; apostille not required but recommended

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Power of Attorney appointing the licensed Samoan Registered Agent and authorizing corporate filings (Statutory agent appointment form)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the signatory's jurisdiction (attesting identity and capacity)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory CDD screening of all directors, 25%+ shareholders, UBOs and authorized signatories against the UN Security Council Consolidated List, Samoa FIU Targeted Financial Sanctions List, OFAC SDN List (best-practice benchmark), INTERPOL Red Notices, APG/Commonwealth consolidated debarment lists, and the Samoan domestic criminal-asset freeze registry; PEP status (including immediate family and close associates) triggers enhanced due diligence per AML/CFT Act 2018 sections on politically exposed persons; adverse media and bankruptcy/global sanctions checks repeated at incorporation, at each change of ownership, and on an annual cycle; all screening evidence must be retained by the registered agent for not less than 5 years post-termination of the business relationship.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Companies Office of Samoa - Registrar of International Companies, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL); official name-search and reservation lodged via the licensed Samoan registered agent on the MCIL Companies Office portal
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: English is the statutory filing language; an International Company name must be expressed in Roman script, ending with 'Limited', 'Ltd', 'Corporation', 'Incorporated', or 'Société Anonyme' or acceptable short-forms; non-Roman-script commercial names (including Chinese-language virtual brand names) may be referenced in a bilingual charter annex only if accompanied by a notarized romanized transliteration and certified English translation lodged with the Registrar; the legal-effective name remains the English/Roman-script name
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: or any token implying public patronage, sovereign immunity, or professional exclusivity absent prior written ministerial/regulator consent
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the registered agent re-lodges within 14 days via the MCIL portal with a written letter of appeal to the Registrar of International Companies attaching: (i) the original rejection notice, (ii) written consent of the relevant supervisory authority for sensitive tokens, if applicable, and (iii) registration evidence of the trademark or goodwill for contested names; if the Registrar maintains the refusal, a further administrative appeal lies to the Minister of Commerce, Industry and Labour within 30 days; no formal hearing is granted unless the Minister determines a substantive right is at stake; the 30-day reservation may be renewed twice by payment of the statutory extension fee before expiry; failure to file incorporation within the reservation window releases the name to the public pool.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Fully permissible for an offshore International Company: the International Companies Act 1987 mandates only a licensed registered agent and a registered office within Samoa, which may be the agent's licensed business address; no physical ghost-kitchen premises, equipment, staff, or onshore operational presence is required in Samoa for the holding or brand-licensing entity; however, if onshore Samoa-based food production or delivery were ever contemplated, a Business License under the Business Licenses Act 1998 and a food handling certificate from the Ministry of Health would become mandatory; the offshore IC may hold the virtual food-delivery brand IP and channel UberEats/DoorDash payouts without local substance
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Quantified low risk: file-level desk review probability approximately 5% per annum of an unannounced record inspection triggered by the FIU AML/CFT supervision cycle or the Registrar's random compliance sweep; physical on-site inspection of the registered agent's premises occurs on a defined AML supervisory cycle, currently assessed at under 10% probability in any given year for the agent as a whole, and near-zero probability for the individual IC file absent adverse media or suspicious transaction reports.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act 2017 (Samoa), as amended, ss. 3 (incorporation), 8 (memorandum), 9 (articles), 12 (registered office), 15 (registered agent), and 20 (certificate of incorporation)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Samoa International Finance Authority (IFA) — Registry of International Companies, Apia
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association of the International Company (Form A) submitted with the IFA, final issuance of Certificate of Incorporation
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital; the Memorandum must state at least one share of par value, fully paid or subscribed as stated, and no escrow account deposit is required prior to incorporation
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED THAT the Company adopts its Memorandum and Articles of Association as filed with the Samoa International Finance Authority; that the registered office of the Company shall be at the address of its licensed registered agent in Apia, Samoa; that the initial subscriber shareholding is approved and the directors are authorized to issue shares for cash or other consideration; that the persons named director, secretary, and resident agent are appointed to hold office until the next annual general meeting; and that the directors are authorized to open bank accounts, execute delivery-platform agreements, and take all steps necessary to obtain food premises and operating licenses.

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name availability inquiry via the licensed registered agent or to IFA Registry; provide the proposed company name in English or Samoan, confirm the name is not identical or misleadingly similar to an existing registered international company, and pay the name reservation fee where required.
required_dossiers: Identification of the licensed registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected, file a written appeal under the IFA name grievance procedure with alternative name options or request a review on the ground of distinctiveness and non-confusion.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Execution of Memorandum and Articles
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed registered agent on behalf of the IFA Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the Memorandum and Articles of Association in English, state the authorized share capital, adopt the permitted restricted-object clause for delivery-only kitchen operations, have the initial subscriber sign before a notary or authorized witness registered in Samoa, and obtain the registered agent's consent to act.
required_dossiers: Statement of subscriber(s) and initial shareholding
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the IFA queries corporate purpose or share capital wording, file an amended instrument correcting the defective clause; administrative resubmission is cured within five business days upon payment of any resubmission fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the signed Memorandum and Articles together with the incorporation application form, registered agent appointment form, statutory declaration of compliance, and the prescribed government fee. The application may be filed electronically through the licensed agent; the IFA will issue a Certificate of Incorporation once the documents are determined compliant.
required_dossiers: Registered agent consent and address in Samoa
Payment receipt for state filing fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is placed under query, respond in writing to IFA with amended instruments or additional explanation within 14 days; failure to respond may require a fresh application with preserved filing date.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation and Corporate Seal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval IFA will issue the Certificate of Incorporation, which certifies the International Company is incorporated under the International Companies Act 2017. The Company may adopt a corporate seal if desired; the registered agent will obtain certified copies of the Certificate for banking and licensing purposes.
required_dossiers: Approved Memorandum and Articles of Association
Certificate of Incorporation issued by IFA
Certified copy of Certificate of Incorporation for banking
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Any material error in the Certificate may be corrected by submitting a written request to IFA with supporting evidence; rectification typically completes within five business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Appointment of First Directors and Officers
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Call the first meeting of the board, approve the pro-forma first board resolution, appoint directors, secretary, and resident agent as required, and record the resolution in the company’s statutory minute book. File the notice of directors and registered office with IFA where required.
required_dossiers: Minutes of the first board meeting
Consent to act of each director
Consent of secretary and registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If IFA rejects the notice of appointment due to incomplete director particulars, submit a revised notice within 5 business days with corrected identification details.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Ministry of Revenue (Samoa) / Samoa International Finance Authority
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the International Company for tax purposes with the Ministry of Revenue, obtain a Tax Identification Number, and confirm eligibility for the international company exemption regime. If the company elects to carry on physical activity in Samoa, register for the appropriate business and food premises licenses under the relevant Samoan legislation.
required_dossiers: Declaration of exempt activity where applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If tax registration is delayed or queried, supply the missing certified documentation or seek ministerial waiver; the International Company exemption certificate may be obtained through IFA to support tax status.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministry of Health (Food Safety Unit) in conjunction with the Samoa International Finance Authority and Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour for food business operating approval
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Food Business Operator's Licence and Food Premises Registration under Samoa Food Act 2014 (available to ghost kitchen / delivery-only cloud kitchen facilities)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (MNRE) — Planning and Urban Management Agency, Samoa
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category 2 — Environmental Registration and Environmental Declaration for small-scale food preparation / delivery-only kitchen operations; full EIA Report required only if waste discharge or emission volumes exceed prescribed thresholds
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Compliance with Samoa Water Quality Standards and Waste Management Act 2010: trade wastewater discharges require screening and oil/grease traps; VOCs and cooking fumes must be filtered to minimise odor and air pollution; solid waste segregation, collection, and disposal through licensed waste carriers; no discharge of untreated grease or food waste to public drains.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Certificate from the Samoa Fire and Emergency Services Authority (SFESA); structural load inspection and building compliance certificate from the Ministry of Works, Transport and Infrastructure; occupational health and workplace clearance from the Labor and Employment Relations Division of the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour; work site hygiene inspection by the Ministry of Health.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Samoa Revenue Authority (SRA), a semi-autonomous agency under the Ministry of Finance; taxpayer portal: SRA e-Services (https://www.revenue.gov.ws). Registration of International Companies is separately administered by the Registrar of International Companies within the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-owned International Company (IC) incorporated under the International Companies Act 1987 is issued a certificate of incorporation and an IC number by the Registrar of International Companies. Because an IC is statutorily exempt from all Samoa taxes, it is not obliged to obtain a TIN unless it carries on prohibited local taxable activities in Samoa (which ICA 1987 restrictions otherwise bar). If such local activities arise, the IC must apply to SRA for a Tax Identification Number using the prescribed IRD-01 registration form, accompanied by the certificate of incorporation, registered agent details, beneficial ownership identification, and notarized constitutional documents; SRA will issue the TIN and register the entity for GST if the relevant threshold is met.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone: The IC is classified as a non-resident offshore company under the International Companies Act 1987 (as amended by the International Companies (Amendment) Act 1998) and is statutorily exempt from Samoa income tax, Goods and Services Tax, stamp duty, and all other Samoan taxes for a 20-year period, which exemption may be extended through a tax exemption certificate. The exemption remains valid only while the IC derives no Samoa-source revenue and does not carry on business with Samoan residents.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Samoa has no check-the-box, flow-through, or hybrid-mismatch election mechanisms. The only statutory elections applicable to a Samoa IC are: (i) applying for a Tax Exemption Certificate under the International Companies (Amendment) Act 1998 to secure the statutory 20-year tax holiday; (ii) electing to migrate/re-domicile as an ordinary resident company under the Companies Act 2019, which would irrevocably subject the entity to Samoa income tax and GST (10%) on its world-wide and Samoa-source income; and (iii) electing to commence onshore commercial activity with SRA registration and loss of offshore exempt status, an election that must be notified to the Registrar of International Companies and the Central Bank of Samoa.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Goods and Services Tax (GST) — enacted under the Goods and Services Tax Act 2021, replacing the Value Added Goods and Services Tax (VAGST) regime; administered by the Samoa Revenue Authority.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Compulsory GST registration applies where annual taxable turnover exceeds SAT 100,000; voluntary registration is available from SAT 60,000 annual turnover. Non-resident persons making taxable supplies of digital or remote services to consumers in Samoa may be required to register for GST regardless of turnover, subject to the non-resident supplier and reverse-charge provisions of the Goods and Services Tax Act 2021.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Samoa does not operate a mandatory real-time e-invoicing, fiscal clearance, API, or digital stamping regime for GST. However, every GST-registered supplier, including ghost kitchen and virtual brand operators settling through UberEats and DoorDash payment rails, must issue a tax invoice with prescribed particulars at the time of supply, show the SRA GST registration number and itemized GST at 10%, and retain complete electronic records, accounting and delivery-log audit trails for a minimum of seven years. GST returns and payments are lodged electronically through SRA e-Services on the applicable periodic filing cycle.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating applies to: (i) the physical export of goods from Samoa where the supply is made within 28 days before or after the date of export and is substantiated by an outward customs declaration; and (ii) a supply of international/offshore services performed outside Samoa or supplied to a non-resident customer located outside Samoa at the time of supply, provided the services are not performed for a Samoan resident. For the virtual brand ghost kitchen operation, zero-rating is limited to demonstrable offshore sales involving the genuine cross-border movement of goods; delivery orders fulfilled and consumed within Samoa through UberEats or DoorDash remain taxable at the standard 10% GST rate.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration evidencing physical outward movement of goods from Samoa
Bill of Lading / Air Waybill evidencing export shipment from Samoa
Inward Remittance Certificate evidencing repatriation of export proceeds in accordance with Central Bank of Samoa exchange control
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: SRA may audit zero-rated export claims retrospectively for up to seven years. Where zero-rating is claimed without genuine export or without the mandatory customs declaration and FX repatriation evidence, SRA will assess GST at 10% plus default interest, disallow and claw back all input tax credits claimed in connection with the export, and impose a civil penalty of up to 200% of the tax shortfall. In cases involving fraudulent intent or false documentation, criminal penalties apply: a fine of up to SAT 200,000 and/or imprisonment for up to seven years, together with suspension or revocation of the GST registration of the delivery operator.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Samoa (Falepuna, Apia), exercising statutory powers under the Exchange Control Act 1976, the Financial Institutions Act 2016, and the International Financial Services Authority (IFSA) for offshore International Company supervision.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Samoan Tala (WST) is a managed-float currency. Samoa has accepted Article VIII of the IMF Articles of Agreement, so current-account payments and transfers are unrestricted; residual exchange-control approvals under the Exchange Control Act 1976 apply mainly to capital-account transactions. International Companies (ICs) are treated as non-resident for exchange-control purposes: they may freely maintain foreign-currency (USD) accounts, contract in any currency, and remit dividends, liquidation proceeds, and service fees offshore without CBS conversion h hurdles. Profit remittance is subject only to company-law solvency tests and IFSA annual return filing; no additional CBS exit tax or SDR surrender applies to ICs.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Resident exporters must collect payment within 90 days from shipment date and surrender 100% of export proceeds to an authorised dealer in Samoa within 30 days of receipt, converted into WST unless a CBS exemption is granted. International Companies operating under the International Companies Act 1987 are exempt from the mandatory surrender and conversion regime because they are non-resident and prohibited from carrying on business with Samoan residents without CBS approval; accordingly their export/operating proceeds may be retained in USD or any approved settlement currency in offshore or domestic USD accounts.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Conditionally viable (Medium feasibility). Samoa has no standalone Electronic Money Institution (EMI) licensing regime under the Financial Institutions Act 2016; money transfer and payment services require a CBS money-remittance licence or an agency arrangement with a licensed Samoan financial institution. Offshore digital EMIs (e.g., UK FCA or Singapore MAS licensed) are legally usable for inbound platform payout aggregation on behalf of the IC, but they cannot serve as the master settlement account because CBS exchange-control reporting requires the final settlement account to be held at a Samoan authorised dealer. Recommended structure: use an FCA/MAS-licensed EMI as a virtual-account payment aggregator for UberEats/DoorDash payouts, then timely sweep to the master USD operational account at ANZ Samoa or BSP Samoa.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical appearance of all directors is not statutorily mandated for IC account opening; the CBS AML/CFT rules and the Samoan Financial Intelligence Unit impose a risk-based CDD regime. Remote onboarding is acceptable if each signatory director undergoes a live video-conference KYC interview, provides a notarised and apostilled passport copy, and the Samoan licensed registered agent attends the bank in Apia in person with the corporate kit. At least one natural-person senior manager or beneficial owner (25% threshold) must present for interview where the account is expected to clear high-throughput delivery-platform settlements.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: International Company with no physical Samoan operations, fully offshore board, and no local revenue evidence
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified Certificate of Incorporation under the IC Act 1987, Constitution, Certificate of Incumbency, Register of Directors and Shareholders, Beneficial Ownership Return filed with IFSA, registered agent's signed undertaking, and an apostilled board resolution authorising account opening and naming the authorised signatories.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Ghost kitchen / virtual brand model lacking a verifiable physical operational footprint, raising trade-description concerns
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed UberEats and DoorDash payout/master-service agreements, cloud kitchen facility lease or hosting agreements (including third-party host kitchen proof of occupancy), virtual brand licensing documentation, food safety and trade licensing approvals, 12-month cash-flow and transaction forecasts, and a group organisation chart mapping ownership and operational flow.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-velocity USD sweep flows from US food delivery market aggregating to a small island offshore IC
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Source-of-funds and source-of-wealth statements from the beneficial owner, last 12 months of platform settlement statements, pro-forma audited financials, CBS-compliant IMF Balance-of-Payments purpose codes for each wire, and an executed indemnity and warranty from the beneficial owner confirming no domestic Samoan business is conducted.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Single natural-person beneficial owner holding 100% equity interest with no institutional co-sponsor
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Enhanced due diligence file: completed CDD questionnaire, director's bio/passport/apostille, tax-residence certificate, professional reference letter from another licensed financial institution, wealth-origin narrative, and negative media/sanctions screening report from a reputable compliance data vendor.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Subscribe equity or shareholder loans by SWIFT MT103 from the beneficial owner's bank to the IC's USD account at a Samoan authorised dealer (ANZ Samoa or BSP Samoa). Beneficiary reference must recite the corporate composite key “EQUITY SUBSCRIPTION – WS__WS__WS_IC__ISIC_5610_05_GHOST_KITCHEN_VIRTUAL_BRANDS” and the IMF BOP classification for direct investment equity (C.4) or loan (C.3.2.4). The authorised dealer will capture the inward remittance for CBS external statistics; the IC must file corresponding share-register updates and a board resolution instructing the bank to credit the subscription. A Foreign Investment Certificate under the Foreign Investment Act 2000 is not required for an IC holding a valid licensing concession, but a copy should be retained where the apex group holds a domestic subsidiary.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Use SWIFT MT103 for standard trade payables (raw ingredient procurement, packaging materials, SaaS kitchen-management software, cloud kitchen facility lease rentals) with invoice cross-referencing and BOP purpose codes; use MT202 COV for inter-account sweeps. For capital equipment imports (commercial ovens, cold storage, point-of-sale hardware), an irrevocable commercial Letter of Credit (L/C) at sight or with deferred payment is the preferred rail, issued by ANZ Samoa through a confirming bank in the supplier's jurisdiction. Delivery-platform settlement is received inbound from UberEats/DoorDash aggregators via US ACH/API payout engines into the EMI virtual account or directly to the master USD account, then deployed onward by MT103 to host-kitchen operators, independent delivery-network drivers, and royalty payees. All outbound disbursements must be accompanied by the underlying trade document pack (invoice, shipping evidence, or service attestation) to satisfy CBS authorised-dealer external-remittance reporting.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Short-dated USD/WST deliverable forward contract executed with a CBS-authorised dealer in Samoa (standard tenor up to 12 months)
Non-deliverable forward (NDF) on USD/WST quoted by an offshore correspondent bank where local interbank liquidity or tenor limits constrain a deliverable forward
Cross-currency swap (USD/WST) with a licensed financial institution for matching the IC's operational WST funding needs against USD platform settlements
Currency option (zero-premium collar or purchased call/put) on USD/WST for conditional hedging of large capex disbursements

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return of the International Company (Form IC-AR / Statement of Particulars)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA) – Registrar of International Companies
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days after each anniversary of the date of incorporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Bundled with the annual government fee; late filing attracts a surcharge of 10% per month on the unpaid annual fee and, if the default is not remedied within 30 days of the Registrar's written notice, the IC is administratively struck off the International Companies Register.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Government Licence and Renewal Fee (renewal of tax-exempt international company status)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA) – Registrar of International Companies
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before the anniversary of incorporation; SIFA observes a 30-day grace period before penalties accrue
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Standard fee for authorized capital not exceeding US$1,000,000 under the International Companies (Fees) Regulations. Non-payment accrues a 10% per month late surcharge; continued default beyond a 30-day Registrar notice results in administrative strike-off, with assets vesting in the Government of Samoa.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Ownership Register Confirmation (UBO / annual confirmation statement)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: SIFA-licensed registered agent (filed with the Registrar; subject to inspection by the Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Concurrent with the annual return; shareholder changes and transfers of virtual-brand interests must be registered within 14 days of the change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to maintain or confirm the beneficial ownership register is an offence under the International Companies Act 1987 and the AML/CFT Act 2007; penalties may be imposed on directors and the registered agent, and the Registrar may refuse renewal or strike off the IC for repeated default.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Economic Substance Notification / Return (relevant activity: intellectual-property business; virtual-brand and ghost-kitchen trademark licensing)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA) – Economic Substance Unit / Registrar of International Companies
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 12 months after the end of the IC's financial year, aligned with the anniversary return cycle
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: An IC engaged in a relevant activity must document Samoa substance; non-filing attracts escalating financial penalties and, for continued non-compliance, the Registrar may strike off the company and the tax-exempt status may be revoked.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No compulsory statutory audit applies to a Samoa International Company under the International Companies Act 1987. An independent certified audit is required only if (i) the board and shareholders pass a special resolution to appoint an auditor, (ii) an investor, lender, or franchise acquirer contractually requires audited financial statements, or (iii) the IC is found to be carrying on business in Samoa. The default ghost-kitchen / brand-holding position is audit-exempt.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: The IC must retain accounting records sufficient to show and explain its transactions (including digitally sourced ghost-kitchen revenue trails and royalty streams). Where financial statements are voluntarily prepared for investors or substance documentation, they should be prepared in accordance with IFRS as adopted in Samoa or the group's home-country GAAP; no accounts are filed with the Registrar and no public disclosure is required.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: A register of beneficial owners must be kept at the Samoan registered office and updated in writing with the registered agent within 14 days of any share transfer, allotment, or change in ownership or control. Concurrently with the annual return, the registered agent files an annual confirmation of beneficial ownership with the Registrar. The ghost-kitchen virtual-brand entity must identify every natural person holding at least 25% of the IC's shares or control rights; failure to confirm renders the entity non-compliant for renewal.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: US$450 – US$1,200 per annum for a SIFA-licensed registered agent and registered office
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not statutorily required; voluntary certified audit by a SIFA-licensed practitioner typically US$2,500 – US$5,000 per engagement

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% (Samoa International Company exemption; otherwise 27% for resident companies)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: International Companies under the International Companies Act 1987 are statutorily exempt from all Samoan corporate income tax, capital gains tax, and withholding taxes. No tax holidays or preferential deductions apply. Exempt status is preserved by annual government fee payment and registration in the International Companies Registry.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: IC-AR1 / IC-TE1 (Annual Return and Tax Exemption Confirmation) via Samoa International Companies Registry (SICR) online portal at MCIL.gov.ws; copy transmitted to Samoa Ministry of Revenue for tax exemption tracking.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due within 30 days after the anniversary of incorporation for the IC-AR1; the IC-TE1 nil income return is due no later than six months after the International Company's fiscal year-end (default 31 December).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered name and IC registration number of the International Company.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the exact legal name and certificate number issued by the Samoa International Companies Registry; do not use trading names or DBA labels.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Samoa street address of the registered office and the name of the licensed international company agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A physical post-office box is insufficient; the non-resident directors must ensure a licensed resident agent is appointed and identified.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: The fiscal year end selected by the company.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Unless a different period has been approved by the Ministry, select 31 December; all exemption declaration deadlines run from this date.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration that the IC did not derive income from a Samoan trade or business and holds no Samoan real property.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If the IC receives delivery-platform settlements while operating solely abroad, tick 'No Samoan source income' and attach a treasury account statement evidencing upstream settlement flow.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Names, addresses, and percentages of all direct and indirect beneficial owners.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: List ultimate natural persons or the ultimate holding entity; nominee-held shares must be disclosed to the registered agent for the AML register.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing of IC-AR1/IC-TE1 incurs a daily penalty of WST 100 up to WST 5,000. Continued default exceeding 90 days permits the Registrar to strike the company off and forfeit limited liability. Materially false declarations impose criminal penalties including imprisonment up to 7 years.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% (International Company distribution exemption; a 15% resident-company dividend WHT applies only outside the IC regime)
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: For an IC, no Samoan withholding tax is deducted from dividends, interest, or royalties paid to non-resident shareholders because the IC is tax-transparent in Samoa. To benefit from an applicable double tax agreement in the recipient jurisdiction, the shareholder must obtain a Samoa Tax Residence Certificate (TRC) from the Samoa Ministry of Revenue, complete Form WHT-TR1, and submit the TRC, dividend resolution, and share registry extract to the foreign withholding agent. The treaty protocol is procedural only and does not alter the 0% Samoan rate.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory Samoan non-resident withholding rates are 15% for both debt interest and IP royalties. Treaty-reduced rates, available under Samoa's limited DTA network (e.g., Australia and New Zealand), typically range from 5% to 12.5% but require prior TRC submission. For International Company payments that are not sourced in Samoa and have no local nexus, the effective withholding rate is 0%.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: WST 1,000,000 aggregate controlled transactions (Local File); WST 5,000,000 total revenue (Master File)
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Samoa's Economic Substance Act 2019 applies to International Companies carrying on relevant activities. A ghost kitchen or virtual brand operation is a relevant activity if physically conducted in Samoa as a 'distribution and service center'. A purely digital brand generating orders abroad and settling via offshore delivery platforms has no Samoan physical nexus and incurs no ESR filing. Any local hiring, kitchen premises, or domiciled delivery logistics in Samoa triggers an ESR return requiring migration of management and control to Samoa, adequate local staffing, premises, and income proportionality.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The IC physically operates a cloud kitchen in Samoa selling to local consumers but continues to claim the tax-exempt 'offshore company' status and fails to register for domestic corporate income tax.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Underpayment of 27% corporate tax on all Samoan-source profits, interest at 9% per annum, plus a penalty equal to 100% of the evaded tax. Criminal indictment may impose imprisonment up to 7 years.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are personally assessed for unpaid taxes where the company is a sham or where dividends were paid in lieu of tax. Travel bans and departure prohibition orders can be issued; asset seizure covers disguised payments and related-party distributions.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The IC is maintained as a paper shell with a Samoa agent and bank account only, receiving UberEats and DoorDash settlement funds while the entire virtual-brain operation is run by non-resident managers abroad, and no economic substance return is filed.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: ESR noncompliance penalties up to WST 20,000 per return plus WST 5,000 per day of continuing breach. The Registrar may restrict bank accounts, suspend commercial authority, or strike the company off.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign false ESR declarations are disqualified from managing a company for up to 5 years and may be ordered to pay restitution personally. Beneficial owners cannot rely on the corporate veil to shield assets where nominal directorship was used.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The IC channels high-volume delivery-platform payouts to foreign owners without maintaining a beneficial ownership register, neglecting Customer Due Diligence for platform settlement agents, or using crypto intermediate entities to avoid transaction traceability.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fines up to WST 150,000 for the corporate entity and WST 75,000 for officers under the Samoa Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act; bank freezes and revocation of any financial service license.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors with actual knowledge carry criminal liability up to 10 years' imprisonment; civil penalties attach to rejected wire transfers and complicit money laundering through delivery settlement accounts.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The IC charges the foreign operating company inflated royalty or kitchen-management fees, designed to shift taxable profit from a high-tax country into the Samoan exempt IC, without any arm's-length benchmarking.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Tax authorities may adjust the controlled transactions, assess additional corporate tax, and levy a 20% penalty. A cross-border mispricing adjustment by a treaty partner triggers additional Samoan documentation penalties up to WST 10,000.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors approving misleading contemporaneous evidence are jointly liable for penalties; they may personally be sued for indemnity by the affected operating company and face regulatory disqualification for neglect.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Failure to File Annual Return / False Declaration
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The IC repeatedly misses the annual IC-AR1/IC-TE1 filing deadline or submits a nil declaration while active Samoan kitchen operations, local riders, and local deliveries are traceable from platform records.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Daily late penalty of WST 100 up to WST 5,000; after 90 days the Registrar may strike off the IC. The Ministry of Revenue can issue a default assessment based on estimated platform sales turnover and may recover through garnishment.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors lose representative immunity after strike-off; courts may impose restitution orders, travel restrictions, and a 3-year directorship ban, and release ultimate beneficial owners as jointly liable where false filings concealed actual business operations.
